title: Stretch Top (AlignAndSize)

scenarios.title: Stretch Top applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Stretch Top (BtnStretchTop) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnStretchTop deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed StretchTop moves the top edge to the reference's bottom edge (the bottom edge stays; the reference itself and geometrically ineligible shapes are untouched); the feature reports execution, the unselected shapes are untouched, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed StretchTop moves the top edge to the reference's bottom edge (the bottom edge stays; the reference itself and geometrically ineligible shapes are untouched); the feature reports execution, the unselected shapes are untouched, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
